introduction:
👋 Hello! My name is Freya and I live in NYC now.

👩🏻‍💻 I am currently pursuing my masters degree at NYU and looking for 2027 New Grad roles in Data fields.

🎓 I am completing an M.S. in Management and Analytics at New York University. Finished my Bachelor of Management in Administrative Management at Chongqing University of Technology. 

💪 Specialties in analyzing customer and business data from online services and applying insights to actionable strategies.
💻 Programming: Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), R, SQL, Java
📊 Data Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Excel
🗄️ Database & Tools: MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Spark, Git, SPSS
📈 Statistics & ML: A/B Testing, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, K-Means Clustering
🤖 AI: LLM Applications, Prompt Design, RAG, LangChain

🔥 Aspire to become a data analyst who can translate data into clear business decisions and customer-centric growth strategies.

💼 Previously, interned at Google, NielsenIQ, and AI Solutions across advertising analytics, consumer research, and data platform work. I automated KPI reporting with Tableau dashboards and deeply dived into ad performance and consumer insights using SQL, Python, and Excel, and I also built data pipelines and AI features on the development side.

🚀 As for my future, I want to become a data-driven analyst who can read customers unmet needs through data and help teams make better decisions.

✈️ In my free time, I love traveling, 📸 photography, 🎬 video editing and🎮 playing games.

➡️ To know more about me, please visit my portfolio below or DM me!
